_read_me: You can change the numbers and word lists below right on GitHub. Click the pencil icon, edit, then click Commit changes. The next hourly update uses the new settings.
_shipping_help: Listings with calculated shipping are looked up one at a time to get the real price to your ZIP. Each listing is looked up only once and remembered, so after the first fill-in only brand new listings use calls (a handful per day). This is the most lookups allowed in one update.
_hide_words_help: Any listing whose title contains one of these words or phrases is hidden. They usually mean the set is opened, used, incomplete, fake, or a bundle.
_maybe_hide_words_help: These words usually mean a loose figure or just the paperwork, so the listing is hidden UNLESS the title also says sealed, NISB, MISB or new in box.
_box_warning_help: Listings that mention these words still show up (the set is still sealed) but get a yellow 'box damage mentioned' tag.
_ok_phrases_help: These phrases are ignored before checking the hide list, so 'never opened' does not count as 'opened'.
